test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.**

Honesty as well as discipline __are required to succeed in life.__

options.text: are requirement to succeed in life
is required to succeed in life
has required to succeed in life

solution:
The correct answer is: **is required to succeed in life.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "are required to succeed in life" needs to be substituted to match the singular subject "Honesty" which is being combined with "discipline" using the phrase "as well as," which does not make the subject plural.
 
• When "as well as" is used, the verb agrees with the first subject, which in this case is "Honesty," hence the singular verb "is" should be used.
 
• The correct substitution maintains the meaning and grammatical integrity of the original sentence.

Therefore, the sentence with the correct substitution is: *"Honesty as well as discipline **is required to succeed in life."***

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 "are requirement to succeed in life" **is grammatically incorrect because "are" does not agree with the singular subject, and "requirement" is a noun, not a verb.
 
• **Option 3 "has required to succeed in life" **incorrectly uses "has," which is not appropriate for the present tense or the infinitive "to succeed."
 
• **Option 4 "No substitution" **is incorrect because the verb needs to be singular to match the singular subject.
